title: Cursor failClosed empty allow stdout blocks writes

narratives.Intent: Cursor preToolUse deposits use failClosed:true; empty allow stdout is treated as hook failure and blocks Write/StrReplace. Emit explicit {"permission":"allow"} for Cursor allow decisions.
narratives.Acceptance: renderHostDecision('cursor', allow) returns permission allow JSON; denials unchanged; other hosts keep empty allow; tests + CHANGELOG updated; ApplyPatch adapter also normalizes empty success to allow.
